status: The known unconnected-station raw-wdev async lifetime and stale-interface stack-disclosure paths are source-level corrected; physical firmware, recovery and teardown qualification remains outstanding.

defects.request_lifetime: The vendor callback returned after queuing a raw wireless_dev pointer; the serializer later dereferenced it and emitted a cfg80211 event without retaining its owner.
defects.error_event_initialization: A failed first mtlk_df_user_from_wdev lookup reached the event path before vendor_unconnected_sta_res_data was initialized.

changes: replace the void asynchronous core request with synchronous serialized invocation and clipboard cleanup
retain the nl80211 vendor callback and its wiphy lifetime until the request and event complete
initialize address, RSSI defaults and all remaining response bytes before the first interface lookup

assertions: NL80211_CMD_VENDOR requires a wiphy and does not bypass the wiphy mutex
nl80211_pre_doit locks the wiphy and releases RTNL before the callback
nl80211_vendor_cmd calls the driver doit with the resolved wiphy and wdev

lifetime_test.result: PASS: synchronous unconnected-station request retains callback lifetime
structural_checks: no asynchronous invocation remains in the submit function
synchronous invoke, result processing and callback return are ordered
response initialization precedes the first stale-interface exit
response initialization has one unambiguous owner

full_driver_suite.sanitizers: ASan/UBSan where provided by each harness
full_driver_suite.scope: Extracted production functions plus modeled kernel, serializer, DMA, workqueue, firmware and callback leaves; not a running target kernel.
